Be Here Now by Ram Dass

https://smile.amazon.com/Be-Here-Now-Ram-Dass/dp/0517543052

I know of three spiritual teachers who describe psychedelics as a door to the spiritual world.

Ram Dass the Jewish Psychology Professor at Harvard/Hippie/Hindu. See his famous book Be Here Now. [1] He passed away last year

Fr. Stephen De Young and Fr. Stephen Damick (PhD), Eastern Orthodox Christian priests. Psychedelics are mentioned near the end of episode 2 of their podcast. [2]

stt: What’s the strangest thing you ever found in a book?
x:
I buy interesting looking books from Thrift stores, and the weirder the better.

I found a copy of a book called, "You are becoming a Galactic Human":

https://www.thriftbooks.com/w/you-are-becoming-a-galactic-hu...

Which was weird, but that's not the strangest thing I've ever found IN a book.

That spotlight belongs to a thrifted copy of "Be Here Now" by Ram Dass:

https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/41580312-be-here-now

Which is also a very strange and interesting book, but inside of it, bought from  a thrift store, I found a pressed Marijuana leaf, which I still have. I would have thought that they would at least riffle the pages of the books to make sure there was no money or anything in it but somehow this leaf slipped through.
